pi_method: Machin identity with 16 alternating rational terms for each arctangent
sin_method: Alternating Taylor through degree 19 with degree-21 remainder, midpoint interval enlarged using global Lipschitz constant 1 and clipped to [-1,1]
radial_integral_method: Monotone phase boxes with global Lipschitz sine enclosure and exact rational Riemann sums
scope: Scalar continuous a>=4/5 and retained feedback K<=0 only. No nonlinear embedding, normal ball or strong-target claim.
